meta.title: 7ayLabs · The lab that publishes its misses
meta.description: 7ayLabs builds apps, engines, models and on-chain tools, and runs them in public. First out: Vizzor, crypto intelligence that puts a deadline on every call and grades it.

footer.tagline: The lab that publishes its misses.

hero.title: A lab that publishes its misses.
hero.sub: 7ayLabs builds apps, engines, models and on-chain tools, then runs them where anyone can watch. Vizzor went first: it puts a deadline on every crypto call and marks it right or wrong when the clock runs out.

board.title: In the lab right now
board.nextLine: Not announced yet. We show things when they work.

fields.title: One bench, four trades.
fields.lede: The person who trains the model sits beside the one who draws the screen. That is deliberate: a product gets good when its parts are allowed to argue.

apps.title: Apps
apps.line: What you actually touch. If it needs a tutorial, we got it wrong.

software.title: Software
software.line: The plumbing: data in, answers out, records kept. Dull when it works, which is the point.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.line: Models that have to explain themselves. An answer with no reasoning behind it does not leave the building.

onchain.title: On-chain
onchain.line: Wallets, payments and contracts on public chains, where the ledger does the vouching.

method.title: House rules.
method.lede: Four of them. They cost us speed and we keep them anyway.

receipts.title: The record beats the pitch
receipts.line: If we say it works, a public page shows whether it did.

plain.title: No manual
plain.line: If a question needs special syntax, the product is not finished.

privacy.title: Take only what the feature needs
privacy.line: This site keeps an email if you hand us one. Nothing follows you around.

ship.title: Small, often, written down
ship.line: Every release gets a note the day it lands, the dull ones too.

receipts.practice: Every Vizzor call is marked right or wrong at its deadline. The wrong ones stay up.

plain.check: Open Vizzor and type a question

privacy.practice: No trackers. An email or a message is stored only if you send it.

ship.practice: Each release is written up the day it lands.

updates.title: What shipped, and when.
updates.lede: Dated notes, newest on top. No roadmap theatre.

faq.title: Asked often, answered straight.
faq.lede: If yours is missing, the contact form reaches a person.

stack.title: We own every layer, down to the metal.
stack.lede: Screen, engine, model, chain, server: all built here. When something breaks, the person who can fix it is already in the room.

interface.name: Interface
interface.line: Web first, and installable on a phone.

engine.name: Engine
engine.line: Pulls the data, runs the models and writes every call down before its outcome is known.

models.name: Intelligence
models.line: ChronoVisor, our own model. It reads the market and has to show how it reached its answer.

chains.name: Chains
chains.line: {count} blockchains read at the source, plus the wallets people already carry.

ground.name: Ground
ground.line: Our own servers on a private network, backed up every night. No release goes out with a failing check.

reach.title: {count} chains, read at the source.
reach.lede: Not somebody's summary of a blockchain. Vizzor asks the network itself, so a transfer is looked up where it happened.

contact.title: Tell us what you are building.
contact.lede: Or just ask something. Every message is read by a person.

products.title: Vizzor calls it. The clock decides.
products.lede: Target, deadline, confidence. When time is up the call gets its mark, and the mark stays, whichever way it went.

predict.name: Predict
predict.title: A call with a deadline on it.
predict.line: Direction, target and confidence up front, with the entry, two exits and the stop if you mean to act on it.

whales.name: Whales
whales.title: Big wallets move before the chart does.
whales.line: Vizzor watches them and shows where the money is heading while it is still on its way.

forensics.name: Forensics
forensics.title: Stolen funds leave a trail.
forensics.line: Follow it wallet to wallet and chain to chain, on a map you can actually read.

markets.name: Markets

next.title: The next one is still on the bench.

what.a: A lab. We build our own products and run them in public. Vizzor is the first.

vizzor.a: Crypto intelligence. Ask about a token, a wallet or a tokenized stock and it answers with a call that has a target, a deadline and a confidence. At the deadline the call is marked right or wrong, where everyone can see.

relation.a: 7ayLabs is the lab. Vizzor is the first thing to come out of it. This site covers the lab; the product lives at vizzor.ai.

free.q: Can I try Vizzor for free?
free.a: Yes. The free plan lets you ask, get calls and follow the record. Paid plans read deeper and answer more per day. Current plans are on vizzor.ai.

work.q: How do I reach the team?
work.a: Through the contact page, for partnerships, press, security or a plain question. For help with Vizzor itself, its docs are faster.

more.a: Yes, and they are being built now. You will hear about each one when it works, not before.

meta.title: Vizzor · AI crypto intelligence, graded in public
meta.description: Vizzor is crypto intelligence from the 7ayLabs laboratory: price calls with a target, a deadline and a confidence, whale flow and on-chain forensics. Every call is graded in public.

vizzorPage.title: Every call gets a deadline. Every deadline gets a verdict.
vizzorPage.lede: Vizzor reads price, on-chain flow and the story behind a token, wallet or tokenized stock, and commits to a call. Then it waits for the clock like everyone else.

how.title: Ask it. Get a call. Watch the clock.
how.lede: Three steps. Most tools stop after the second.

ask.title: Say it your way
ask.line: “ETH, 4 hours, $500 at 10x.” That is a complete question.

call.title: It commits
call.line: Direction, target, deadline and confidence, with a plan: an entry, two exits and a stop.

grade.title: The clock rules
grade.line: At the deadline the call is marked right or wrong and added to the record. No edits.

desks.title: Four desks feeding one call.
desks.lede: Each does one job. None of them gets to hide behind the others.

predict.name: Predict
predict.line: The call itself: target, deadline, confidence and a trade plan around it.

intel.name: Intel
intel.line: Whale flow, smart money, wallet tracing and hack watch.

markets.name: Markets
markets.line: Prices, a heatmap and the day's movers.

record.name: Track record
record.line: Everything Vizzor has called and how each one ended. Misses included.

editions.title: One model, three depths.
editions.lede: ChronoVisor comes in three editions. Your plan decides how deep it reads and how often it answers.

items.zonda: Ask, get a call, follow the record. Enough to judge it.
items.kat: Reads deeper and answers far more often. For people who trade every day.
items.zuor: The whole model, forensics included, with no daily ceiling.

editions.note: Prices and what each plan includes are kept up to date on Vizzor's own site.

whales.title: Whale terminal
whales.line: See large holders move as it happens, with a heatmap of where the money is going.

forensics.title: Forensics map
forensics.line: Follow funds from wallet to wallet and across blockchains after a hack or a suspicious move.

wallets.title: Wallets and portfolio
wallets.line: Link your own wallets and see your holdings, your changes and your graded calls in one view.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.line: Get a push notification when a price, a wallet or a call you follow does something.

news.title: News desk
news.line: The stories moving the market, read for you, with early signals before they are widely reported.

skills.title: Skills
skills.line: A directory of ready-made ways to analyse a market, and a lab to combine them into your own.

communities.title: Communities
communities.line: Rooms and channels for trading groups, where anyone can ask Vizzor right in the chat.

ranking.title: Leaderboard and seasons
ranking.line: A public ranking of traders by their own graded calls, with 30-day seasons and daily challenges.

receipts.title: A record nobody gets to tidy up.
receipts.lede: A track record means something only while the bad days are still in it.

points.public: Every call is published before its outcome is known.
points.sealed: The record is sealed every day, so past calls cannot be changed afterwards.
points.misses: Wrong calls are shown next to right ones, with the same weight.

reach.title: {count} blockchains, read live.

mission.title: Predictions are cheap until someone keeps score.
mission.p1: Crypto is full of confident calls nobody revisits. The right ones get quoted for years. The wrong ones are quietly deleted.
mission.p2: We thought a tool that gives advice should carry its own scoreboard, in public, where the people leaning on it can read it.
mission.p3: That became Vizzor. The same rule now applies to everything else on our bench.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: This page covers 7aylabs.com only. Vizzor has its own privacy policy on vizzor.ai, because it is a different service that handles different data.

scope.title: Who is responsible
scope.body: 7ayLabs operates this site and decides how the data described here is used.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: If you subscribe to updates: your email address and the language you were reading in. If you send a message: your name, email address, topic and the message itself, plus a scrambled fingerprint of your network address that we use to stop abuse and cannot turn back into the address. We do not use analytics, advertising trackers or tracking cookies. Your theme choice is stored in your own browser and never sent to us.

use.title: What we use it for
use.body: To send the updates you asked for and to answer your message. Nothing else. We do not sell data and we do not build profiles.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: Your subscription stays until you unsubscribe or ask us to remove it. Messages are kept for as long as the conversation needs and then deleted.

share.title: Who else handles it
share.body: The site runs on a server we rent, behind a network provider that protects it from attacks, and email is delivered by an email provider. They process data on our behalf and only to provide those services.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of what we hold about you, have it corrected or have it deleted. Write to us and we will do it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this page changes, the date at the top changes with it.
